_note: Synthetic counterparties for the intake pipeline. `contacts` are the exact mailboxes a counterparty registered with us when onboarded; a message from any other mailbox, whatever its display name claims, is an unknown sender. Freemail providers (gmail, yahoo, outlook) are common for small vendors and contractors, so trust is anchored on the exact registered address, never on the domain or the display name.
_lifecycle_note: `lifecycle` is the payee's state at onboarding: status NEW | VERIFIED | ACTIVE, the registered phone a call-back must use, who verified it. The execution store holds the live record from then on (bank changes, call-backs, payments); the bank-details fingerprint comes from data/beneficiaries.json. Phone numbers are synthetic (555 / 7946 0958 ranges).
